player_prompt.intro:
Agkalabas ka na Minesweeper game.
Say layun na ed game so ibunyag iray cell ya agko anggaan na mina.
Panon ya gawaen so move, ipasabi lamang so row tan column coordinates ya ibunyag mo using say format:
- `[row col]`: Ibunyag so cell ed specified row tan column.
Halimbawa:
- `[3 2]` ya ibunyag so cell ed Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` ya ibunyag so cell ed Row 5, Column 6.
Ed unaan mo ya move, ibunyag mo met so area ed paligid na cell ya piliwen mo ya asegurado so panayaman.
Say kasalukuyan ya board layout so ipapakita ed baba. Iray cell ya agko ibunyag so represented na dot ('.'), revealed numbers so ipapakita so bilang na adjacent mina.
Agkalabas ka so agko ibunyag ya cell.
Natan so kasalukuyan ya board layout:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Agmo inebatan iray valid a coordinate ed saray kuadrado iran parente.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Say specified row tan column coordinates so out of bounds.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Say cell ed ({row}, {col}) so ibunyag na.

outcome.win: Komendasyon, matalona kayon akalinisan ed Minesweeper board.
outcome.turn_limit: Asumpal lay limitasyon na panag-turn. Sikay matalona ya akaukit ed {percent}% na saray maligen a selula.
